correctness.rationale: The stated six-state chain has a unique stationary distribution because the landscape has a unique invariant distribution and the conditional occupancy contraction satisfies max|s_i-c_i|<1. Direct balance yields pi diag(c)(I-PD)^{-1}1. Time reversal preserves the determinant, whose positivity follows from the strictly bounded spectral radius. A general three-state stationary flow parameterization reduces the adjugate difference identically to J times the signed (c,s) area. The exact polynomial identities were verified from the included checker, including a six-state direct stationary calculation and 50 rational cases. Finite tests are supplementary and no nonstationary convergence is claimed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: These works supply encompassing methodology, but an evaluated formula for arbitrary separate stationary occupancy does not by itself state the strict sign/equality criterion under environmental time reversal. The closest general model has nontrivial endogenous connectivity, while the present claim concerns independent external colonization. No dominating theorem implying this exact comparative sign law without new three-state cancellation was identified; a general matrix-based implication remains the main residual risk.

originality.rationale: The precise all-parameter three-stage time-reversal occupancy difference and the if-and-only-if signed-area criterion were not found in the materially inspected 2014 dynamic-landscape model and 2006 backward-succession paper. The former provides a general occupancy/Markovian landscape framework, the latter constructs the reverse chain for retrospective first-passage questions; neither states or establishes the tested joint occupancy orientation law. Existing general matrix-resolvent techniques can compute the answer separately and are acknowledged as a remaining possible source of implication, not confused with independent priority proof.

value.rationale: The source literature motivates ecological succession with irreversible multi-stage habitat cycles. The result determines which succession direction increases stationary occupancy, identifies the exact additional response-geometry condition required beyond irreversible circulation, and proves sharp necessity/sufficiency plus the minimal three-state threshold; no fitted transition parameters or open-ended case enumeration are needed. The observable provides a concrete distinction between ecologically identical stage frequencies with different stage histories.
